-- S5 is deliberately additive and dark.  It records the coordinator's
-- immutable identities and staged response before Dialog delivery, without
-- changing legacy jobs or enabling the feature.
ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD COLUMN source_message_version BIGINT,
    ADD COLUMN reply_to_message_id UUID,
    ADD COLUMN coordinator_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
    ADD COLUMN response_assistant_ui JSONB,
    ADD COLUMN response_assistant_ui_digest CHAR(64);

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_source_message_version_ck
        CHECK (source_message_version IS NULL OR source_message_version > 0),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_coordinator_mode_ck
        CHECK (coordinator_mode IN ('legacy', 'onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_response_assistant_ui_ck
        CHECK ((response_assistant_ui IS NULL AND response_assistant_ui_digest IS NULL)
            OR (coordinator_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND response_assistant_ui IS NOT NULL
                AND response_assistant_ui_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'));

-- 017 predates a coordinator response: it requires a TeacherDecision for all
-- delivery-pending/delivered jobs.  A unified onboarding turn intentionally
-- has no fake decision; it has a staged, digest-bound Dialog response instead.
ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check
        CHECK (
            (status = 'queued' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'processing' AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL)
                    OR (decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'delivery_pending' AND response_body IS NOT NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((coordinator_mode = 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'delivered' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND (teacher_turn_schema_version = 1 OR teacher_response_message_id IS NOT NULL) AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL AND (terminal_outcome IS NULL OR terminal_outcome = 'delivered') AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((coordinator_mode = 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'completed' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome = 'failed_no_effect' AND reconciliation_state IS NULL AND no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL AND recoverable_outcome_id IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL
                AND ((delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL)
                    OR (reconciliation_state = 'committed_unreconciled' AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND teacher_response_message_id = delivered_message_id)))
        );

-- A normal delivered S5 clarification can still be the result of a durable
-- Student no-effect proof.  Keep that proof linked to the dense outcome as
-- well as the cursor; a failed_no_effect outcome uses the same evidence plus
-- its Teacher-generated recoverable outcome ID.
ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_turn_outcome
    ADD COLUMN no_effect_proof_id UUID,
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_turn_outcome_proof_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (no_effect_proof_id) REFERENCES teacher_dialog_turn_proof(no_effect_proof_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction (
    interaction_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    prompt_message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    prompt_message_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (prompt_message_version > 0),
    prompt_assistant_ui_digest CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (prompt_assistant_ui_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    slot_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (slot_code IN (
        'direction_code', 'self_assessed_experience', 'known_stacks', 'desired_stacks',
        'goal_code', 'goal_text', 'preferred_language', 'weekly_minutes', 'preferred_pace'
    )),
    expected_draft_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (expected_draft_version >= 0),
    expected_profile_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (expected_profile_version >= 0),
    state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'superseded', 'completed')),
    reserved_teacher_job_id UUID,
    reserved_action_receipt_id UUID,
	reservation_mode VARCHAR(32),
    superseded_by_interaction_id UUID REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_interaction(interaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((state = 'active' AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
        OR (state = 'reserved' AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text') AND completed_at IS NULL
            AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
        OR (state = 'superseded' AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
        OR (state = 'completed' AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text') AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
            AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL))))
);

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_action_receipt_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (reserved_action_receipt_id) REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_action_receipt(idempotency_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_reserved_job_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (reserved_teacher_job_id) REFERENCES teacher_dialog_job(teacher_job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_id_receipt_key UNIQUE (interaction_id, reserved_action_receipt_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_interaction_one_open_dialog
    ON teacher_onboarding_interaction (dialog_id) WHERE state IN ('active', 'reserved');
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_interaction_reservation_job
    ON teacher_onboarding_interaction (reserved_teacher_job_id) WHERE reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_interaction_reservation_receipt
    ON teacher_onboarding_interaction (reserved_action_receipt_id) WHERE reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_interaction_prompt_version
    ON teacher_onboarding_interaction (dialog_id, prompt_message_id, prompt_message_version);

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_turn (
    teacher_job_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    source_event_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    interaction_id UUID REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_interaction(interaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    coordinator_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (coordinator_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')),
    stage VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('received', 'interaction_reserved', 'ai_staged', 'student_staged', 'response_staged', 'delivery_pending', 'delivered', 'failed_no_effect', 'blocked_unknown')),
    action_receipt_id UUID,
    causal_ai_execution_id UUID,
    fallback_ai_execution_id UUID,
    student_command_id UUID NOT NULL,
    response_command_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_effect_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_attempted' CHECK (student_effect_state IN ('not_attempted', 'accepted', 'no_effect', 'unknown_effect', 'committed_unreconciled')),
    no_effect_proof_id UUID,
    recoverable_outcome_id UUID,
    response_assistant_ui_digest CHAR(64),
    semantic_decision JSONB,
    semantic_decision_digest CHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((coordinator_mode = 'onboarding_action') = (action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (coordinator_mode <> 'onboarding_action' OR interaction_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (NOT (causal_ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL AND fallback_ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((student_effect_state = 'no_effect') = (no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((stage = 'failed_no_effect') = (student_effect_state = 'no_effect' AND recoverable_outcome_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((stage <> 'failed_no_effect') OR recoverable_outcome_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK ((stage = 'failed_no_effect') OR recoverable_outcome_id IS NULL),
    -- A turn begins received/not_attempted. Delivered is constrained one-way;
    -- it must never turn that valid initial state into an impossible row.
    CHECK ((stage <> 'delivered') OR (student_effect_state IN ('not_attempted', 'accepted', 'no_effect'))),
    CHECK ((response_assistant_ui_digest IS NULL) OR response_assistant_ui_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CHECK ((semantic_decision IS NULL AND semantic_decision_digest IS NULL)
        OR (coordinator_mode = 'onboarding_text'
            AND semantic_decision IS NOT NULL
            AND semantic_decision_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            AND semantic_decision ? 'kind'
            AND NOT semantic_decision ? 'result')),
    CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_job_event_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (teacher_job_id, source_event_id) REFERENCES teacher_dialog_job(teacher_job_id, event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_interaction_receipt_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (interaction_id, action_receipt_id) REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_interaction(interaction_id, reserved_action_receipt_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_student_command_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (student_command_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_response_command_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (response_command_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_action_receipt_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (action_receipt_id) WHERE action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_causal_ai_execution_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (causal_ai_execution_id) WHERE causal_ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_fallback_ai_execution_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (fallback_ai_execution_id) WHERE fallback_ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX teacher_onboarding_turn_stage_idx
    ON teacher_onboarding_turn (stage, updated_at);
